title: 🗣️ Repo language table and parsing records
description: Single source of truth for the repo language plugins. `🔣️languages.json` validates against `#/$defs/languageTable`; every implementation (Rust, Go) loads that table verbatim and interprets the declarative pattern language below. Host regular expressions are forbidden: a pattern is an ordered token list matched anchored at the start of a single line with ordered backtracking, which reproduces Go RE2 leftmost-first submatch semantics exactly.

definitionKeywords.description: 🔑️ The vocabulary that turns a matched definition line into a raw kind. `multiWord` is searched first as a case-insensitive substring of the whole match, then the word immediately preceding the captured name, then the first non-modifier keyword.

definitionKindMap.description: 🗺️ Lowercased raw kind to canonical definition kind. Anything unlisted is `implementation`.

refinements.description: ✨️ Unanchored searches that promote a `const`/`let`/`var` binding to `function` when its initialiser is callable. Applied to the whole definition line.

registry.description: 🔢️ Ordered language names consulted by extension lookup. Order is behaviour: the first entry whose extension list contains the lowercased file extension wins.

scopeRegionMarker.description: 💬️ The comment-prefix-agnostic region marker reader used by the scope builder. Prefixes are stripped once each, in order, from a trimmed line before the keyword test; the marker only counts when the remaining text starts with an entity emoji.

scopeDefinitionPatterns.description: 🔭️ Extension-keyed patterns used by the scope builder. Deliberately coarser than a language's own definition pattern: a scope definition is one line, and the first pattern that matches wins.

sectionEngine.description: 🧭️ Which section reader applies. `markers` walks sectionStart/sectionEnd patterns; `markdownHeadings` walks ATX headings with frontmatter offsetting; `jsonKeys` walks object keys with byte offsets; `none` produces no sections.

definitionEngine.description: 📏️ How a matched definition line is given an end line. `braces` balances `{`/`}`; `indent` closes on the first non-blank line indented no deeper than the opener; `rubyEnd` tracks Ruby block depth and closes on `end`.

orphanDefinitions.description: 🧷️ Extra single-line definitions a language contributes outside the definition pattern.

auxPatterns.description: 🧰️ Extra named patterns a language's definition engine needs (Ruby's `end` line and block openers).

stringFeatures.description: 🧵️ Lexical features a comment scanner must honour. Consumed by the statutes module, carried here because it is language data.

sectionNaming.description: 🏷️ How a section name becomes the identifier written by the section formatters. `modName` lowercases and underscores the name for the Rust `mod` wrapper.

format.description: 🖊️ A section marker template. `{name}` is substituted with the section name; `{modName}` with its `modName` normalisation. No host format-string dialect is involved.

ci.description: 🔠️ Match ASCII letters case-insensitively, as Go's `(?i)` flag does.

v.description: 🔤️ Literal text (`lit`), ordered literal set (`anyOf`), repeated character (`repChar`) or accepted character set (`charIn`).

of.description: 🧬️ Sub-token list (`opt`, `rep`), list of alternative token lists (`alt`) or the single captured token (`cap`).

section.description: 📑️ One parsed section. Lines are 1-based inclusive; indices are 0-based byte offsets into the content.

scopeEntry.description: 🪪️ One addressable scope inside a file. `id` follows the scope-id grammar: `file:<path>`, `section:<path>#<sectionPath>`, `def:<path>#<sectionPath>::<name>` and, with no section, `def:<path>#<name>`.

header.description: 🧾️ The decomposed fields of a file header region, as written and read back by the header formatter.
